items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: Just last night I was watching two of Monk interviews, one by Ray Brown that I didn’t know about yet, and one by Sweets Edison.

ctx.x: Louie Bellson on drums? Wow. Well Pierre, we came to the end of our program. I’d like to thank you once again for being here with us today because it wasn’t easy with the Covid-19 pandemic to be with us today. So I’d like to thank the Fola Jazz Club once again also for welcoming us, and good-bye for now.

Good-bye, it’s been such an honor and a pleasure because you made me realize that I got so lucky to be around all these people at that time, and I still do performing on the road. Just last night I was watching two of Monk interviews, one by Ray Brown that I didn’t know about yet, and one by Sweets Edison. So you helped me to do some kind of —
Yeah. I mixed up both characters in the interview.
